svg.text: What Tank watches, what it does with each new item, and what the operator receives. Tank only reads data and never trades; every decision stays with the operator.
Source: 01 PRD v2.3 (16 Oct 2026). Formulas and thresholds behind each step are in 03 TDD; processes and integrations in 02 HLD.
What Tank watches
Step of the main flow
Tank stays silent (no card)
What the operator receives

text.tspan: WHAT TANK DOES WITH EACH NEW ITEM

svg.text: Sees every new item within its source's max delay and records the moment
Tank first knew
Stores the original; an exact duplicate (same id or same text) is counted on the
item it repeats
Checks news, GitHub commits and posts of founders, C-level and the
other accounts: is it about crypto?
Sends every item to its event: the same event as one with news in the
last 3 days → it joins that event's analysis, even while it is running; a
new event → a new analysis
For this step Tank can read any site or API, search everything it has collected
and run its own calculations
One event per real-world fact: the press release, the X posts and the news
about it become one event
Every fact carries a verbatim quote from its source
Stage — how far the change has really gone: rumor → proposed → approved
→ signed → deployed → live → money flowing; Tank marks whether an official
source confirms that stage
Freshness — Tank judges when the fact really became public: fresh ≤ 1 h ·
normal ≤ 4 h · medium ≤ 8 h · poor ≤ 24 h · old ≤ 48 h · stale beyond
Certainty: high — official source: the organization's site or announcement, its
official X account, its founders or C-level team, or a fact Tank sees itself (the
market already trades) → goes on at once · medium — likely (e.g., a reliable
reporter) → Tank checks the official sources right away and goes on; the card
marks what is verified · low — implausible or an unknown author → recorded
Tank can look up numbers and context on the web and in its own data, and
run its own calculations
Class by written criteria (PRD §6.3); the card names the criterion met:
STRUCTURAL SHOCK — verified and changes for good who can or must
hold the token, or its supply (e.g., The Clearing House picks Quant)
MAJOR — verified new fact about a universe token: listing on a major
exchange, integration with a large company, launch, token-economics change,
regulator decision, hack, treasury sale (e.g., Altman: "We will integrate WLD
and OpenAI")
MATERIAL — proposals, small partnerships, minor updates · LOW — no
universe token concerned
The 7 scores below (0–10, each with a reason) explain the class on the card:
1) Direct economics — does it create real fees, demand, burns, staking or
collateral use?
2) Size — how big is the effect for the project and the token?
3) Permanence — one-off or lasting change?
4) New access — can new capital or new users come in?
5) Forced flows — buybacks, burns, mandated buying or collateral?
6) Surprise — did the market expect it?
7) Stage — rumor → proposed → approved → live → money flowing
Also: how much of the money reaches the token (direct · indirect · story only ·
unknown) and when the effect starts

text.tspan: Map who benefits and who loses

svg.text: Tank searches the web and its own history for each layer
8 layers: issuer/product · trading venue · settlement chain · liquidity/execution ·
lending/collateral · oracles/data · interoperability · custody/compliance
Primary tokens, up to 4 secondary beneficiaries, up to 2 losers; names the
least-repriced beneficiary

text.tspan: Measure what the market is really doing

svg.text: Windows 15 m · 1 h · 4 h · 24 h · since the event, all at one fixed cutoff
Spot buying/selling per venue and combined: how many venues agree and
how much volume they carry
Open interest in token units (new positions vs price effect) · funding per venue ·
liquidations: complete or sample · liquidity and price impact
How much is already priced: moved against the event · not yet · early ·
substantial · heavy
What moves the price, one of: spot buyers leading · spot and moderate
leverage together · perp traders chasing · short squeeze · buying absorbed by
a seller · selling absorbed by resting buyers · holders selling into strength ·
price markup without new positions · thin book, price jumps on little flow ·
venues disagree · unknown
Data confidence high / medium / low and the weakest input named
Direction · potential · best horizon (1 h … 7 d) · base, upside and failure
scenarios, each in words
No open call: START · WATCH-TO-START · WAIT · DON'T CHASE
On a call Tank started: HOLD · ADD · REDUCE · EXIT, for long positions; Tank
follows a call for up to 7 days
Two grades decide the action: thesis A–D (how strong the event is for this
token) and trade A–D (how good the entry is right now)
START needs high data confidence
Checks the card: MAJOR or STRUCTURAL SHOCK · certainty high or
medium · freshness FRESH to OLD · the event is open · the 18 hard
rules of PRD §8

<STRUCTURAL SHOCK | MAJOR> (criterion met) — one neutral
sentence
Seven scores · stage · certainty · freshness (fresh … old) with
public and known times · data confidence high / medium / low
VERIFIED / NOT VERIFIED — what is confirmed and by which
source; what is not
WHY IT MATTERS — what changed · economic effect · how
much reaches the token
WHO — primary · secondary (layer, state) · loser
MARKET TRUTH — what moves the price, 2–3 facts with window
and unit, how much is priced
OUTLOOK — bias · potential · best horizon · base / upside /
failure
WHAT TO DO — action · thesis grade · trade grade
WHAT CHANGES THE ACTION — one condition up, one down
CONFIDENCE — low / medium / high and the main unknown
≤ 3,500 characters, up to 3 tokens
STRUCTURAL SHOCK: first card ≤ 3 min after Tank learns of it;
the full card follows in the same thread
MAJOR: full card ≤ 8 min
Every card version is stored with its evidence — sources, quotes,
market data, every analysis step — and can be reproduced
Updates go as replies in the card's thread when an action, the
grade, the stage or its verification, or a decisive condition
changes, the event is denied or a call ends; at most 1 per 15 min
— START, EXIT and broken theses at once
DELIVERY FAILED (5 attempts)
HEARTBEAT daily at 08:00 UTC
Every card with its versions, evidence, delivery status and the
move that followed
Labels for cards: CATCH · LATE · FALSE ALARM · NOISE; for
events without a card: CORRECT SILENCE · MISS
Scout proposals: approve for testing · test more · reject
no → the event stays monitored

text.tspan: Closer watch after a MAJOR grade

svg.text: Once step 3 grades an event MAJOR or higher, Tank checks the
official sources of its organizations every 15 s for 2 h, and around a
known milestone (vote end, effective date, launch) from 5 min
before until confirmed or 2 h after, to catch a confirmation, details
or a denial fast
Steps 2–7 are one continuous analysis. Later news about the event
(a repeat or a development within 3 days), an official denial, a
milestone or a fired condition is added to it, even while it runs →
the steps it affects run again → a threaded update when a decision
changes
A beneficiary layer, market behavior or discovery path outside the
known patterns → a proposal to the operator, who approves
testing
